summary: refactor(settings): move inline TOTP step state and guard to container
description:
Because:
- Review feedback: keep currentStep and the MFA guard in the container so
  the page component stays presentational.

This commit:
- Move currentStep + navigateBackward + MfaGuardCore into container.tsx.
- Extract InlineTotpEnrolment to its own file (stays under the guard).
- Reduce index.tsx to a presentational AppLayout + step-dispatch shell.
- Return to the intro on guard dismiss; use CardLoadingSpinner while loading.
- Split enrolment tests into InlineTotpEnrolment.test.tsx; trim comments.
